name: ports
description: Publishes the ports the project lists in PORTS: whatever the agent serves on one reaches this machine through one central proxy shared by every sandbox, and shows as a button on its session. Nothing listed → does nothing.

settings.label: Ports to publish
settings.description: Space-separated ports the sandbox opens: a server listening on one is published on this machine and shown on its session. Empty: none.

settings.label: Publish ports on
settings.description: Address the sessions' ports are published on; 0.0.0.0 for your whole network. Default: where the web UI listens.
